Tsukasa Shiratori, Nadeshiko Washio and Mikage Kotooka are three close-knit friends in junior high school. For almost a year, Tsukasa has been harboring a secret she can't tell anyone: she has a crush on Nadeshiko. She resigns to keep it locked away forever, but then discovers that Nadeshiko has a crush on Mikage. Not wanting to mess up their current relationship, Tsukasa decides to support Nadeshiko in any way she can. However, Mikage has a secret of her own that she can't share with anyone.

description.pt-br:
Conta a história de três melhores amigas e a de dois rivais/amigos/inimigos cujas histórias se entrelaçam entre si.

Tsukasa, Nadeshiko e Mikage tem sido melhores amigas desde o começo do Ginasial. No entanto, Tsukasa mantém um segredo por mais de um ano: ela está apaixonada por Nadeshiko. Para não acabar com harmonia da amizade das três, Tsukasa se mantém calada sobre isso. No entanto, a situação se torna mais complexa quando ela descobre que Nadeshiko está também apaixonada, mas não por ela mas sim sua outra melhor amiga: Mikage. Tsukasa então luta contra seus sentimentos, entrando em conflito consigo, para dar apoio a sua amiga. Além disso, Mikage também guarda um segredo...

No outro lado da história, Tsukasa recebe uma declaração de um garoto bem próativo e popular em sua escola: Asakura-kun. No entanto, ela possui um irmão gêmeo idêntico a ela, Subaru, com o qual troca de lugar vez ou outra. Subaru, sendo super apegado a sua irmã, não gosta nenhum pouco disso. No entanto, tem um gosto em comum com o tal Asakura que considera seu rival/inimigo mas que acaba sem querer querendo desenvolvendo uma amizade peculiar.

description.en:
Powerful weapons and magic inevitably come with drawbacks. Fall, possessing the unique skill "Debuff Contractor (Fall Guy)," can absorb these debuffs for his party members, greatly contributing to battles. However, his party members, not believing this to be true, mistakenly believe it's all their own power and banish Fall. Desperate, Fall sets out on an adventure alone to make a living, but unfortunately encounters a dragon. He's hit by its breath and seems to die instantly—but he's unharmed!?

Fall has acquired the strongest body by continuing to absorb everyone's debuffs! An encounter with a beautiful heroine who can't pull out the holy sword, battles against the Demon Lord's army... amidst the turmoil, Fall grows even stronger. Meanwhile, his party members keep failing quests in the face of unfamiliar debuffs... When their skills work together, they're unstoppable!

biography.en:
**Hirohiko Araki** (荒木 飛呂彦, born June 7, 1960) is a Japanese manga artist. He is best known for his long-running series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, which was first published in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 1987 and has sold over 100 million copies as of 2016 in Japan alone.

Araki participated in the Junior Baseball Team in primary school and Kendo Club in middle school. He has a pair of twin younger sisters. Because he was often bullied by his sister, he would hide away to read manga. He liked manga when he was a child, so he wants to be a manga artist. His favorite works are Star of the Giants by Kajiwara Ikki , and Babel II by Yokoyama. Araki had the experience of shaking hands with Tezuka Osamu.

He likes western pop music, horror movies and Italy very much. We can see a lot of the above elements in his representative work JOJO.His painting style was influenced by Renaissance paintings, especially Michelangelo.

He gets up at 10 a.m. every day, draws a Name on Sunday, finishes the draft from Monday to Thursday, rests on Friday and Saturday, and doesn't stay up late. This work and rest lasted more than ten years . The work and rest of this law is influenced by the manga artist [Akimoto Osamu](https://mangadex.org/author/1cd79d33-68b3-4879-b67a-834055ef99eb/akimoto-osamu). Although he is over 50, his face does not show his old state. He is even joked by other manga artists and fans as "the younger he lives", "Immortality", "using corrugation or stone ghost face", "in fact, he is also a Stand, and his ability is that he will not grow old".

biography.en:
Shimizu Aki began her career in the mid-1990s as an illustrator and character designer for magazines, video games, and card games. In 1995, she contributed illustrations to PC Magazine Log In, followed by character design work for the Windows game After Devil Force in 1998 and First Queen: The New World in 1999.

Her early manga contributions include Yato no Kamitsukai ("Blood Sucker: Legend of Zipangu")—a horror fantasy series written by Saki Okuse—and Kumo no Graduale (Graduale der Wolken), both featuring her artwork and published in Comic Birz and Monthly Comic Flapper around 2000.

In 2002, Shimizu expanded into writing as well as drawing with her manga adaptation of the video game Suikoden III (Gensō Suikoden III – Unmei no Keishōsha) in Monthly Comic Flapper, spanning eleven volumes. That same year she began Qwan, an original series that she both wrote and illustrated, running for seven volumes.

Over the years, her bibliography expanded to include works such as Ikyō no Kusa (one-shot), Box of Spirits (Mōryō no Hako), Hyakki Tsurezurebukuro, Kyōkotsu no Yume, NEET Onna to Shōgaku 2-nensei, Tortoise Delivery, Ubume no Natsu, Jorōgumo no Kotowari, Tesso no Ori, Hinatsugimura, the ongoing Chūzenji-sensei Mononoke Kōgiroku (serialized since 2019), Inugami Re, Tsugō no Ii Hate, and the recent Net Keijiban Hyaku Monogatari Series (2024).

Notably, an anime adaptation of Chūzenji-sensei Mononoke Kōgiroku is scheduled for 2025. On the first Suikoden Live it would be announced that Shimizu would be creating a manga adaptation of Suikoden STAR LEAP.

biography.en:
Mitsuru Adachi (Japanese: あだち 充 or 安達 充, Hepburn: Adachi Mitsuru, born February 9, 1951) is a Japanese manga artist. After graduating from Gunma Prefectural Maebashi Commercial High School in 1969, Adachi worked as an assistant for Isami Ishii. He made his manga debut in 1970 with Kieta Bakuon, based on a manga originally created by Satoru Ozawa. Kieta was published in Deluxe Shōnen Sunday (a manga magazine published by Shogakukan) .

Mitsuru Adachi is well known for romantic comedy and sports manga (especially baseball) such as Touch, H2, Slow Step, Miyuki and Cross Game. He has been described as a writer of "delightful dialogue", a genius at portraying everyday life, "the greatest pure storyteller", and "a master manga artist". He is one of the few manga artists to write for shōnen, shōjo and seinen manga magazines, and be popular in all three.

Mitsuru is the youngest in the family, with two older brothers and one older sister. The second brother, [Adachi Tsutomu](https://mangadex.org/author/23fc6623-0e50-411a-a80b-5a8c01b3340a/adachi-tsutomu), was once the assistant of [Akatsuka Fujio](https://mangadex.org/author/609ce7f0-4f06-4074-90c3-5bd714f09e57/fujio-akatsuka), and Mitsuru was also affected in manga because of this, and his first work was also found with the help of his brother. However, after Mitsuru became famous, his brother's work still did not improve, and finally died of illness. Therefore, Mitsuru respected his second brother Tsutomu very much, and often depicted the image of friendly brothers in his manga.

description.en:
Gotsuji and Uruka, two exorcists, spend their days hunting down and banishing evil spirits. Their mission is to track down and slay a specific evil spirit. 

At the heart of this quest lies Gotsuji's deep, unresolved grief and desire for vengeance for a woman who died long ago. While Gotsuji is consumed by a thirst for revenge, Uruka, who struggles to understand this obsession, faithfully stays by his side. 

Together, these two exorcists are bound on a journey, but where will it lead?
___

description.ja: 除霊師の五辻とうるかは依頼を受けて"悪霊"を祓う毎日を送っていた。彼らの目的は、ある悪霊を捜し出して斬ること。そこにはかつて死んだ女性に対する、五辻の強い想いと弔意があった――。 仇討ちに執着する五辻と、それを理解できないながら伴走するうるか。ふたりの除霊師の旅の行きつく先とは…？ バニーと和装で霊を殺（ト）れ！
